meta.title: Tabor Lane — Work that moves
meta.description: A modular Kanban workspace for teams that need clarity, flow and reliable delivery.
hero.eyebrow: A clearer lane for every process
hero.body: Tabor Lane turns scattered requests, projects and operations into visual workflows your whole team can understand — and improve.
hero.note: Free forever · No credit card required
board.title: Product launch
trust.title: One workspace. Any kind of work.
features.title: More than cards in columns.
features.body: Make bottlenecks visible, automate handoffs and connect Tabor Lane to the tools where work begins.
features.flow.title: Flow intelligence
features.flow.body: Track cycle time, throughput, aging work and cumulative flow without building spreadsheets.
features.automation.title: Automations that help
features.automation.body: Assign owners, set deadlines, notify teams and call webhooks when work changes lanes.
features.embed.title: Made to connect
features.embed.body: Use Tabor Lane as a complete workspace or embed its boards into another Tabor product.
features.policy.title: Healthy limits
features.policy.body: Set WIP limits and explicit policies so teams finish active work before starting more.
embed.title: A workflow engine that fits anywhere.
embed.body: A versioned API, webhooks and embeddable boards let every Tabor product share the same reliable process layer.
pricing.title: Start with clarity. Upgrade for scale.
pricing.body: Core Kanban stays useful and free. Premium adds automation, governance and intelligence when your process grows.
pricing.free.name: Free
pricing.free.body: For individuals and small teams building a better way to work.
pricing.premium.name: Premium
pricing.premium.body: For teams that automate, measure and govern important workflows.
pricing.premium.f5: Full history, roles and audit log
cta.eyebrow: Your work already has a path
cta.title: Make it visible. Make it better.
cta.body: Create your first board in minutes and give every request a clear next step.
